verdict.rationale: Attio's own data model lets users define custom objects and lists, and its docs say lists model business processes, so several separate process lists (pipelines) are plausible. Kanban views and stage-conversion reporting suggest stage-based pipelines. However, no evidence states that each list or pipeline can carry its own distinct stage set, or shows multiple pipelines running for different products or motions. Missing for 10: explicit docs on per-pipeline stage configuration, multiple concurrent pipelines with different stages, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run multiple pipelines with different stage sets for different products or motions

citations.quote: Objects can be used to model your domain entities, while lists can be used to aggregate them together and model business processes.
allows you to define custom objects and lists with a wide array of attribute types
From kanbans to tables, visualize your data the way that works for you.
Weighted pipeline ... Pipeline by region ... Stuck deals ... Win rate ... Sales cycle ... Stage conversion
